q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWEE FROM FOLLOW) AND FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY FOLLOWEE ORDER BY FOLLOWEE ASC
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

explanation: Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each followee that is also a follower of another followee.
counterexample_dsp: A test case where a user A follows user B, and user B follows user A, but user A does not follow user C, and user C follows user A. In this case, Q1 will count user A as a follower of user B, while Q2 will not count user A as a follower of user C.
